Third-party components built into emule.exe
===========================================

eMule itself is licensed under the GNU General Public License version 2 or later
(license.txt, one folder up). It is built together with the libraries below, each
under its own license, whose full text is in this folder. The source code of every
component, at the exact version used for this build, is available from the
eMule-build repository (https://github.com/avwarez/eMule-build), where each one is
a git submodule, and from the upstream project.

Component     License                                   Text                      Upstream
------------  ----------------------------------------  ------------------------  --------------------------------------------
Crypto++      Crypto++ compilation license (Boost 1.0)  license-cryptopp.txt      https://github.com/weidai11/cryptopp
id3lib        GNU LGPL version 2                        license-id3lib.txt        https://github.com/avwarez/id3lib
KCP           MIT                                       license-kcp.txt           https://github.com/skywind3000/kcp
libplum       Mozilla Public License 2.0                license-libplum.txt       https://github.com/avwarez/libplum
Mbed TLS      Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later            license-mbedtls.txt       https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls
ResizableLib  Artistic License 2.0                      license-resizablelib.txt  https://github.com/avwarez/resizablelib
zlib          zlib license                              license-zlib.txt          https://github.com/madler/zlib
natd          GNU GPL version 2 or later                license.txt               https://github.com/avwarez/natd

Mbed TLS is used under the GPL-2.0-or-later option, as is the rest of eMule.
